translations.web: They will walk after Yahweh, who will roar like a lion; for he will roar, and the children will come trembling from the west.
translations.bsb: They will walk after the LORD; He will roar like a lion. When He roars, His children will come trembling from the west.
translations.kjv: They shall walk after the LORD: he shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.
translations.asv: They shall walk after Jehovah, who will roar like a lion; for he will roar, and the children shall come trembling from the west.
